readme.run: Register a moving image to a fixed image
notes: Runs the elastix web app's rigid, affine or B-spline preset with the same
ITK-Wasm elastix 2.1.0 build. Writes the registered image, the elastix
TransformParameters files, the ITK HDF5 transform (not for B-spline) and the
OME-Zarr transform. No network connection is required.
The command is elastix-register, so it never shadows a native elastix
installation. Please cite: Klein S, Staring M, Murphy K, Viergever MA,
Pluim JPW. elastix: a toolbox for intensity-based medical image
registration. IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging. 2010;29(1):196-205.
